title: French Train Delays
hook: We've focused a lot on US data over the past few weeks, so many thanks to Mathilda for helping curate this week's French trains dataset! She posted an awesome visualization of this data - if you are interested in a heat-map style geomtile(), take a look at her post The data comes from the SNCF open data portal - there are additional datasets there you can download, but fair to say most things are in French! :smile: The SNCF (National Society of French Railways) is France's national state-owned railway company. Founded in 1938, it operates the country's national rail traffic along with Monaco, including the TGV, France's high-speed rail network. This dataset covers 2015-2018 with a lot of different train stations.
